# @nifrajs/a2a - LLM contract card

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-llm-cards.ts. Do not edit by hand - run `bun run gen:cards`. -->

Mount a nifra agent as an Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol server - the agent card on GET, the A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC binding on POST with SendMessage, streaming SendStreamingMessage over SSE, and GetTask projected from the runner's turn state. A protocol bridge over @nifrajs/agent; the model, state store, and approval transport stay injected per request.

> A tight contract card for AI agents: the exports you actually call + the footguns. For the full
> reference see [`api-reference.md`](../../api-reference.md) (every export + signature) and
> [`llms-full.txt`](../../llms-full.txt) (the prose guides). One cheap read instead of the whole corpus.
